description: Two-operator FM oscillator with a variable waveshape and a dry-to-modulated crossfade

params.text: Sets the frequency of both operators, 20Hz to 640Hz, although the tooltip reads up to 20000hz
Crossfades between the unmodulated carrier and the modulated one
Sets the depth of the modulation
Attenuates the INDEX CV jack before it is added to the INDEX knob; the knob is marked -100% to +100% but only attenuates, reaching zero at the bottom and full at the top
Sets the modulator's frequency as a ratio of the carrier's, in eight steps from an eighth to sixteen times
Trims the modulator ratio between half and double
Blends the operator waveform from sine at the bottom to square at the top
Attenuates the SHAPE CV jack before it is added to the SHAPE knob; the knob is marked -100% to +100% but only attenuates, reaching zero at the bottom and full at the top

inputs.text: Sets the carrier frequency at one octave per volt, five octaves either way from the PITCH knob
Sets the modulator frequency at one octave per volt from the PITCH knob; patching this jack takes the two ratio knobs out of the chain
Adds to the MIX knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held between fully dry and fully modulated
Moves the modulation depth, scaled by the INDEX CV knob and added to the INDEX knob, with the total held inside the knob's limits
Moves the waveshape, scaled by the SHAPE CV knob and added to the SHAPE knob, with the total held inside the knob's limits

notes: Unpatched, the modulator runs at the carrier frequency times the two ratio knobs; patching V/OCT M drives it from that jack instead and the ratio knobs stop working.
The number of voices follows the V/OCT C jack's channel count, up to four.
